title: Graph-level Prediction & Pooling
interviewAnswer: For graph-level tasks, node embeddings must be aggregated into a graph representation using mean/sum/max, attention or hierarchical pooling before prediction.
keyPoints: Sum/mean pooling encode different size behavior.

deepDive: For graph-level tasks, node embeddings must be aggregated into a graph representation using mean/sum/max, attention or hierarchical pooling before prediction.
